records.title: Disability and Ableism in Education
records.header: EDSPE 304 Disability and Ableism in Education (3) SSc, DIV
records.text: EDSPE 304 Disability and Ableism in Education (3) SSc, DIV Covers the topics of disability and ableism specifically focused on educational contexts. Course overlaps with: B EDUC 403 and T EDSP 450.

records.title: Issues and Trends in Inclusive Early Childhood Education
records.header: EDSPE 414 Issues and Trends in Inclusive Early Childhood Education (3) SSc
records.text: EDSPE 414 Issues and Trends in Inclusive Early Childhood Education (3) SSc Integrates basic principles and practices of serving young children with disabilities and their families in homes, communities, and early learning programs. Through interactions with readings, videos, peers, and local experts, students examine real-world challenges related to high quality, inclusive experiences for young children and their families.

records.title: Foundations in Reading and Dyslexia
records.header: EDSPE 415 Foundations in Reading and Dyslexia (3) SSc, DIV
records.text: EDSPE 415 Foundations in Reading and Dyslexia (3) SSc, DIV Provides an overview of theoretical foundations of reading and the characteristics, causes, and treatments of dyslexia. Addresses information about the history of dyslexia, perspectives of people with dyslexia, educational policies and laws related to dyslexia, and educational and technological supports for success in reading and writing text. Recommended: either EDSPE 304, or familiarity with children with disabilities from an educational perspective; and either EDPSY 302, or familiarity with the different ways children develop.

records.title: Introduction to Applied Behavior Analysis
records.header: EDSPE 427 Introduction to Applied Behavior Analysis (5) SSc/NSc
records.text: EDSPE 427 Introduction to Applied Behavior Analysis (5) SSc/NSc Presents an introduction to the science of behavior known as applied behavior analysis. Focuses on basic behavioral principles (e.g., reinforcement), defining behaviors, measuring behaviors, effective strategies to teach new skills, and the ethics involved in behavior change programs.

records.title: Introduction to Autism Spectrum Disorders
records.header: EDSPE 435 Introduction to Autism Spectrum Disorders (5) SSc, DIV
records.text: EDSPE 435 Introduction to Autism Spectrum Disorders (5) SSc, DIV Provides an overview of the characteristics, causes, treatments, and controversies about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Addresses information about the history of the disorder, assessment strategies, and types of interventions.
